item.title: Melmachos #5055 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scatt
item.description: Melmachos #5055 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Lykmedes #5944 the Twice-Born of the Argyreoi fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphode
item.description: Lykmedes #5944 the Twice-Born of the Argyreoi fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend. Lykmedes has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: On the field at the Field of Ares, Akestgenes #923 and Diippos #9453 saw each other across
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares, Akestgenes #923 and Diippos #9453 saw each other across the spears. Their houses are guest-friends. They lowered their weapons, as Glaukos and Diomedes did, and 6 were spared.
